3. When the Writ Petition was listed on 14.08.2025, and 22.09.2025, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner and as such, this Court directed the matter to be listed under the caption 'for dismissal'.
4.
Even though the matter is listed today under the caption 'for dismissal', none appears for the petitioner.
It appears that the petitioner is not interested to prosecute the matter.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.

Miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.

 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Laxmi Narayana Alishetty

opennyai_summary.decision:
This writ petition is filed for the following relief;
"....to issue a writ, order or direction more particularly one in the nature of Writ of Mandamus by declaring the action of the respondents more particularly the respondent No.2 in acquiring 203 sq.yards of land out of 1063 sq.yards in respect of premises No.16-6-33/P or 1, Chaderghat, Hyderabad, which is covering an extent of 10,000 SFT of structure area to an extent fo 203 square yards, towards proposed road widening for laying of Metro Railway Line by the Hyderabad Metro Railway who is respondent No.5 herein, in the absence of paying compensation as per The Right to Fair Compensation and transparency in Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation Act and Resettlement Act, 2013 (Act No.30 of 2013), inspite of receiving the petitioner's representation dt.07-04-2014, as arbitrary, ex-facie illegal, dereliction of duty,
discrimination and violation of principles of natural justice and also against the principles of equity and unconstitutional and consequently this hon'ble court may be pleased to direct the respondent No.2 to acquire the affected portion of 10,000 SFT of structural area of the petitioner's of the aforesaid property by paying compensation under the aforesaid Act by giving him proper opportunity of hearing in the interest of justice and may pass such other order or orders....."
3. When the Writ Petition was listed on 14.08.2025, and 22.09.2025, there was no representation on behalf of the petitioner and as such, this Court directed the matter to be listed under the caption 'for dismissal'.
4.
It appears that the petitioner is not interested to prosecute the matter.
5. Accordingly, the Writ Petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
There shall be no order as to costs.
